chunks: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Aziz b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ammara narrated to us from his father from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) said: A part of me will be buried in the land of Khurasan. No believer will visit it except that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will make Paradise mandatory for him and forbid his body from the Fire.

key_terms.أوجب: Made mandatory / obligated — a strong legal term indicating a binding divine decree
key_terms.الجنة: Paradise — the eternal abode of reward in the Hereafter
key_terms.النار: The Fire — Hellfire, the abode of punishment
key_terms.بضعة مني: A part of me — a prophetic expression denoting a blood descendant who shares the Prophet's spiritual and physical essence
key_terms.خراسان: Khurasan — a historical region in northeastern Iran; the city of Tus (modern Mashhad) is where Imam al-Rida is buried

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the virtue of visiting the grave of his descendant buried in Khurasan?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad foretells that a member of his progeny — understood by Shi'i tradition to be Imam Ali al-Rida (d. 203 AH / 818 CE), the eighth Imam — will be buried in the land of Khurasan (present-day Mashhad, Iran). He then states a powerful spiritual guarantee: any sincere believer who undertakes the pilgrimage to visit that grave will be granted Paradise by Allah and their body will be protected from Hellfire. This tradition has been one of the foundational textual supports for the practice of ziyarat (visitation) to the shrine of Imam al-Rida, which has been central to Shi'i devotional life for over a millennium.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-`Aziz b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Ammara narrated to us from his father from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: A part of me will be buried in Khurasan. A believer will not visit it except that Allah will make Paradise mandatory for him and forbid his body from the Fire.
